primary_metric: mean average precision across clean, 10%, 30%, and 50% MCAR, equal weight; per-seed paired comparison
prior_art_status: Established prior art covers explicit missingness indicators, prediction under mask-distribution shift, synthetic additional missingness in a different gradient-correction setting, and HGB native NaN routing. No exact match for this recipe identified; novelty not established.
limitations: Only three synthetic seeds and one generator; exploratory pilot, no statistical significance claim.
Explicit indicator columns were redundant with native HGB missing-value routing: no-mask ablation matched all recorded scores and mask permutation changed AP by 0.
Held-out result favors the augmentation package in this setting; generalization to real datasets and other missingness mechanisms is untested.
Per-feature Beta rates make copy-level feature missingness propensities heterogeneous, even though each cell is sampled independently conditional on those rates.
decision_rule: Preregistered rule passed: positive mean paired AP delta versus median-HGB and at least +0.02 mean paired AP delta at 50% MCAR. The mask-channel diagnostic fails.
